description.en:
AlphaBot is AI² Robotics' family of embodied-intelligence robots, developed together with its AlphaBrain learning and control system. The platform combines spatial understanding, coordinated whole-body control and multi-step task planning so that perception can inform physical actions.

The company's described applications include machine loading, assembly, material handling and equipment operation, as well as drink preparation and customer interaction in commercial spaces. Its development approach connects robot hardware, training data and deployment experience. Because AlphaBot is a product family, the mechanical configuration and capabilities of an individual unit depend on the model and the application being integrated.
description.zh:
智平方的通用智能机器人AlphaBot系列，是由智平方具身大模型AlphaBrain所定义、以量产为导向的机器人形态，是继智能手机和智能汽车之后，下一个改变世界的智能终端品类。

它具备卓越的空间智能和强大的学习能力，可以像人类一样迅速适应新环境，灵活执行多种任务，无论在企业还是个人应用中，AlphaBot 系列都能为多种多样的任务提供高效、可靠的服务。
